title: Monotonicity of all-branch halting
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine, $x$ an input word, and $t,t'$ natural numbers with $t\le t'$. If every choice word of length exactly $t$ leads from the initial configuration of $M$ on $x$ to a halted configuration, then every choice word of length exactly $t'$ does as well.
hypotheses_covered: Every choice word of length exactly $t$ leads to a halted configuration
replaced:
Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine, $x$ an input word, and
$t \le t'$ natural numbers.  If for every choice word of length $t$ the run of $M$ under
it from the initial configuration on $x$ ends in a halted configuration, then the same
holds for every choice word of length $t'$.
